shortDescription: Manage COE cluster template in OpenStack Cloud

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary containing auth information as needed by the cloud's auth plugin strategy. For the default I(password) plugin, this would contain I(auth_url), I(username), I(password), I(project_name) and any information about domains (for example, I(user_domain_name) or I(project_domain_name)) if the cloud supports them. For other plugins, this param will need to contain whatever parameters that auth plugin requires. This parameter is not needed if a named cloud is provided or OpenStack OS_* environ

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Name of the auth plugin to use. If the cloud uses something other than password authentication, the name of the plugin should be indicated here and the contents of the I(auth) parameter should be updated accordingly.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Named cloud or cloud config to operate against. If I(cloud) is a string, it references a named cloud config as defined in an OpenStack clouds.yaml file. Provides default values for I(auth) and I(auth_type). This parameter is not needed if I(auth) is provided or if OpenStack OS_* environment variables are present. If I(cloud) is a dict, it contains a complete cloud configuration like would be in a section of clouds.yaml.

options.name: coe
options.description: The Container Orchestration Engine for this cluster template Required if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: dns_nameserver
options.description: The DNS nameserver address. Magnum's default value for I(dns_nameserver) is C(8.8.8.8).

options.name: docker_storage_driver
options.description: Docker storage driver.

options.name: docker_volume_size
options.description: The size in GB of the docker volume.

options.name: external_network_id
options.description: The external network to attach to the cluster. When I(is_floating_ip_enabled) is set to C(true), then I(external_network_id) must be defined.

options.name: fixed_network
options.description: The fixed network name or id to attach to the cluster.

options.name: fixed_subnet
options.description: The fixed subnet name or id to attach to the cluster.

options.name: flavor_id
options.description: The flavor of the minion node for this cluster template.

options.name: http_proxy
options.description: Address of a proxy that will receive all HTTP requests and relay them. The format is a URL including a port number.

options.name: https_proxy
options.description: Address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a URL including a port number.

options.name: image_id
options.description: Image id the cluster will be based on. Required if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: insecure_registry
options.description: The URL pointing to users own private insecure docker registry.

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: is_floating_ip_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether created clusters should have a floating ip or not. When I(is_floating_ip_enabled) is set to C(true), then I(external_network_id) must be defined.

options.name: is_master_lb_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether created clusters should have a load balancer for master nodes or not. Magnum's default value for I(is_master_lb_enabled) is C(true), ours is C(false).

options.name: is_public
options.description: Indicates whether the cluster template is public or not. Magnum's default value for I(is_public) is C(false).

options.name: is_registry_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether the docker registry is enabled. Magnum's default value for I(is_registry_enabled) is C(false).

options.name: is_tls_disabled
options.description: Indicates whether the TLS should be disabled. Magnum's default value for I(is_tls_disabled) is C(false).

options.name: keypair_id
options.description: Name or ID of the keypair to use.

options.name: labels
options.description: One or more key/value pairs.

options.name: master_flavor_id
options.description: The flavor of the master node for this cluster template.

options.name: name
options.description: Name that has to be given to the cluster template.

options.name: network_driver
options.description: The name of the driver used for instantiating container networks.

options.name: no_proxy
options.description: A comma separated list of IPs for which proxies should not be used in the cluster.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: server_type
options.description: Server type for this cluster template. Magnum's default value for I(server_type) is C(vm).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long should ansible wait for the requested resource.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not SSL API requests should be verified. Before Ansible 2.3 this defaulted to C(true).

options.name: volume_driver
options.description: The name of the driver used for instantiating container volumes.

options.name: wait
options.description: Should ansible wait until the requested resource is complete.
